research_result.description: Zendesk is a customer service and support platform that offers APIs across ticketing, help center, messaging, live chat, voice, sales CRM, and custom data, along with Model Context Protocol (MCP) support.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a 14-day free trial account or apply for a non-expiring sponsored developer account if creating apps for the Zendesk Marketplace. API OAuth clients and legacy API tokens are managed in Admin Center under Apps and integrations > APIs. Note that legacy API tokens are scheduled for full retirement by April 30, 2027, requiring migration to OAuth 2.0 access tokens.

evidence.claim: Zendesk supports OAuth access tokens, API tokens, and Basic authentication for API access.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.

evidence.claim: API tokens are deprecated and set for permanent deactivation on April 30, 2027.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Zendesk API tokens will be permanently deactivated on April 30, 2027.

evidence.claim: Developers can access Zendesk via a free 14-day trial account or convert it into a sponsored account for development.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account.

evidence.claim: Zendesk's primary APIs are built around REST principles.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Zendesk's APIs are organized around REST principles.

evidence.claim: Zendesk offers a GraphQL API for querying Sell company information and hierarchy.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: GraphQL API for querying company information alongside with Company Hierarchy data

evidence.claim: Zendesk can act as an MCP server exposing tools to third-party AI agents, as well as an MCP client.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Zendesk can also act as an MCP server in other scenarios. In that role, Zendesk exposes tools or resources that third-party AI agents can use to access Zendesk data or perform actions in Zendesk.

evidence.claim: Zendesk APIs span across ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM, and custom data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: You'll find APIs for ticketing, help center, live chat, voice, sales CRM as well as some features that span capabilities, such as omnichannel routing and custom data.
